items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I knew her and we worked the Swanee Inn

ctx.x: But I remember Ivy, and I just adored her. She was a wonderful, wonderful woman, and a marvelous artist. I knew her and we worked the Swanee Inn -- that's the place where Nat worked, Nat King Cole first organized the King Cole Trio.
And that place still exists on Vernon Avenue.
